items.name: Scroll of Speak with Dead
items.description:
You grant the semblance of life to a corpse, allowing it to answer questions. You may ask one question per two caster levels. The corpse's knowledge is limited to what it knew during life, including the languages it spoke. Answers are brief, cryptic, or repetitive, especially if the creature would have opposed you in life.
If the dead creature's alignment was different from yours, the corpse gets a Will save to resist the spell as if it were alive.
If successful, the corpse can refuse to answer

items.name: Scroll of Remove Disease
items.description:
Remove disease can cure all diseases from which the subject is suffering. You must make a caster level check (1d20 + caster level) against the DC of each disease affecting the target. Success means that the disease is cured. The spell also kills some hazards and parasites, including green slime and others.
Since the spell's duration is instantaneous, it does not prevent reinfection after a new exposure to the same disease at a later date.

items.description: When the creatures of the night transform into their more animalistic parts, hunters chasing them only have one alternative to resolve their hunts. Decapitation. items.name: Talking Aroden
items.description: This bust is hand-carved to resemble Aroden, the now-dead god. It has an actuated jaw and a subtle enchantment. It functions as a soul anchor for anyone who dies within 50' of it. After their death, they can be reached through the bust via Speak with Dead. Since multiple souls can be stored within the bust, the name must be known of the person to be spoken with.
